episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Cast aside by Hollywood, screen legends Joan Crawford and Bette Davis battle ageism, sexism and each other when they sign up to make What Ever Happened To Baby Jane?

episodes.title: The Other Woman
episodes.summary: With production on Baby Jane underway, Bette and Joan form an alliance, but outside forces conspire against them.

episodes.title: Mommie Dearest
episodes.summary: As the production of Baby Jane reaches its climax, the feud becomes physical. Bette's relationship with her daughter becomes strained when she bonds with a new cast member. Joan reveals an intimate detail about her past.

episodes.title: More, or Less
episodes.summary: On the eve of its release, bad word-of-mouth plagues Baby Jane. Bette and Joan brace for failure. Pauline tries to break gender barriers. Oscar nominations are announced.

episodes.title: And the Winner Is... (The Oscars of 1963)
episodes.summary: Bette is on track to win a record-breaking third Best Actress Oscar. Joan and Hedda launch a clandestine campaign against her.

episodes.title: Hagsploitation
episodes.summary: Hungry for another hit, Warner pressures Aldrich to bring the original team back together for a follow-up hag horror pic. Someone from Joan's past poses a threat.

episodes.title: Abandoned
episodes.summary: With production of Hush.. Hush Sweet Charlotte underway, the feud is intensified when Joan learns of a new producer on the project. In an unguarded moment, Bette reveals her vulnerabilities to Bob.

episodes.title: You Mean All This Time We Could Have Been Friends?
episodes.summary: Joan accepts a leading role on a new film despite her deteriorating health. Faced with a new rival, Bette reflects on her misplaced feud with Joan.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Truman Capote is the toast of New York society. But a dishy excerpt published in Esquire Magazine threatens to topple him from his precarious perch.

episodes.title: Ice Water in Their Veins
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of the Esquire article, Truman starts on a downward spiral. The Swans form a unified front.

episodes.title: Masquerade 1966
episodes.summary: In 1966, documentary filmmakers the Maysles brothers capture the events leading up to and following Truman's iconic Black and White Ball.

episodes.title: It's Impossible
episodes.summary: Babe makes peace with a harsh reality. Truman makes an effort to get sober.

episodes.title: The Secret Inner Lives of Swans
episodes.summary: November 1975, the day after the Esquire article is published, Truman receives an inspiring visit from a fellow writer.

episodes.title: Hats, Gloves and Effete Homosexuals
episodes.summary: In New York, it's the end of an era. In California, Truman tries to usher in a new era with a hunky beau.

episodes.title: Beautiful Babe
episodes.summary: Babe reflects on her life and her greatest treasures. Truman and the Swans reel in the fallout of a tragedy.

episodes.title: Phantasm Forgiveness
episodes.summary: Past, present and future collide as Truman makes a final push to finish Answered Prayers.
